architecture.context: The governed host owns side effects and evaluates policy before tools.

consequences: Denied calls never reach the mail provider.
decisions.context: A model cannot enforce its own privileges.
decisions.decision: Evaluate send_email at the pre-tool intervention point.
decisions.title: Host-owned tool mediation

assumptions.text: The host mediates every send_email call.

intent.goal: Prevent unapproved external email side effects.
success_signals: All recorded adversarial trials remain blocked.

requirements.statement: The host MUST deny unapproved external recipients.
requirements.title: Mediate outbound email

requirements.statement: The policy path SHALL keep p95 latency below 50 ms.
requirements.title: Bound policy latency

scenarios.then: the host denies the action before mail delivery
scenarios.title: External recipient is denied
scenarios.when: the agent requests send_email to an unapproved domain

scenarios.then: observed p95 policy latency remains below 50 ms
scenarios.title: Policy latency remains bounded
scenarios.when: the host evaluates representative tool calls
